## Implementation Philosophy

This repository prioritizes:

1. **Reproducibility** - Fixed seeds, deterministic generation, full provenance tracking
2. **Simplicity** - Plain text instances, JSON results, minimal dependencies
3. **Performance** - GPU acceleration where it matters (10-100× speedups)
4. **Extensibility** - Modular design, family adapters, standardized interfaces
5. **Transparency** - Open implementations, documented choices, visible trade-offs
